notes.title: Hotfix - v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we just released a quick hotfix update!

There was a bug related to moving your pieces into snowflakes. The undo logic was prone to an error under very specific circumstances which would freeze the piece incorrectly upon undoing, this would repeat unless you restarted the whole level. This has been fixed.

Apologies for any inconvenience this may have caused you!
